orm{\wb_{t-k-1}}_2}{\sqrt{\epsilon}} 	riangleq M_{t-k}$.
nodes.statement_short: Replace v by tilde v; bound the bias by the expected gradient error lemma.
nodes.section: A.10 Proof of Lemma lemma:bound_on_C (Lower Bound on Term C)

nodes.name: Split E
nodes.statement: Then we focus on $E$: \begin{align*} |E| &\leq \underbrace{|\mathcal{G} (g+\delta)|\frac{r^2}{\sqrt{\epsilon+v} (\epsilon + \tilde{v})}}_\kappa + \underbrace{|\mathcal{G} (g+\delta)|\frac{s^2}{(\epsilon + v)\sqrt{\epsilon+\tilde{v}}}}_\rho, \end{align*} due to the fact that $\sqrt{\epsilon+v} + \sqrt{\epsilon+\tilde{v}} \geq \max(\sqrt{\epsilon+v}, \sqrt{\epsilon+\tilde{v}})$ and $|r^2 - s^2| \leq r^2 + s^2$.
nodes.statement_short: Bound |E| by kappa + rho.
nodes.section: A.10 Proof of Lemma lemma:bound_on_C (Lower Bound on Term C)

nodes.name: Bound kappa
nodes.statement: Applying Young's inequality to $\kappa$ with $$\lambda = \frac{\sqrt{1 - \beta_1}\sqrt{\epsilon+\tilde{v}}}{2}, \; x = \frac{|\mathcal{G}|}{\sqrt{\epsilon+\tilde{v}}}, \; y = \frac{|g+\delta|r^2}{\sqrt{\epsilon+\tilde{v}}\sqrt{\epsilon+v}},$$ we obtain \begin{align*} \kappa \leq \frac{\mathcal{G}^2}{4 \sqrt{\epsilon+\tilde{v}}} + \frac1{\sqrt{1-\beta_1}}\frac{(g+\delta)^2 r^4}{(\epsilon + \tilde{v})^{3/2}(\epsilon + v)}. \end{align*} Given that $\epsilon + \tilde{v} \geq r^2$ and taking the conditional expectation, we can simplify as \begin{align} \esps{t- k - 1}{\kappa} \leq \frac{\mathcal{G}^2}{4 \sqrt{\epsilon+\tilde{v}}} + \frac1{\sqrt{1-\beta_1}}\frac{r^2}{\sqrt{\epsilon+\tilde{v}}}\esps{t -k - 1}{\frac{(g+\delta)^2}{\epsilon + v}}. \end{align}
nodes.statement_short: Young's inequality bounds kappa.
nodes.section: A.10 Proof of Lemma lemma:bound_on_C (Lower Bound on Term C)

nodes.name: Bound rho
nodes.statement: Now turning to $\rho$, we use Young's inequality with $$\lambda = \frac{\sqrt{1- \beta_1}\sqrt{\epsilon+\tilde{v}}}{2 r^2}, \; x = \frac{|\mathcal{G}s|}{\sqrt{\epsilon+\tilde{v}}}, \; y = \frac{|s (g+\delta)|}{\epsilon + v},$$ we obtain \begin{align} \rho \leq \frac{\mathcal{G}^2}{4 \sqrt{\epsilon+\tilde{v}}}\frac{s^2}{r^2} + \frac1{\sqrt{1-\beta_1}}\frac{r^2}{\sqrt{\epsilon+\tilde{v}}}\frac{(g+\delta)^2 s^2}{(\epsilon + v)^2}. \end{align} Given that $\epsilon + v \geq s^2$, and $\esps{t-k-1}{\frac{s^2}{r^2}} = 1$, we obtain after taking the conditional expectation, \begin{align} \esps{t - k -1}{\rho} \leq \frac{\mathcal{G}^2}{4 \sqrt{\epsilon+\tilde{v}}} + \frac1{\sqrt{1-\beta_1}}\frac{r^2}{\sqrt{\epsilon+\tilde{v}}}\esps{t-k-1}{\frac{(g+\delta)^2}{\epsilon + v}}. \end{align} Notice that in~\eqref{app:eq:possible_divide_zero_lemmaC}, we possibly divide by zero. It suffice to notice that if $r^2 = 0$ then $s^2 = 0$ a.s. so that $\rho = 0$ and \eqref{app:eq:bound_rho_lemmaC} is still verified.
nodes.statement_short: Young's inequality bounds rho, handling division by zero.
nodes.section: A.10 Proof of Lemma lemma:bound_on_C (Lower Bound on Term C)

nodes.name: Sum kappa and rho
nodes.statement: Summing \eqref{app:eq:bound_kappa_lemmaC} and \eqref{app:eq:bound_rho_lemmaC}, we get \begin{align} \esps{t -k - 1}{|E|} \leq \frac{\mathcal{G}^2}{2 \sqrt{\epsilon+\tilde{v}}} + \frac2{\sqrt{1-\beta_1}}\frac{r^2}{\sqrt{\epsilon+\tilde{v}}} \esps{t -k -1}{\frac{(g+\delta)^2}{\epsilon + v}}. \end{align}
nodes.statement_short: Add the two bounds.
nodes.section: A.10 Proof of Lemma lemma:bound_on_C (Lower Bound on Term C)

nodes.name: Bound r
nodes.statement: Given that $r \leq \sqrt{\epsilon+\tilde{v}}$ by definition of $\tilde{v}$, and that $r \leq \sqrt{k + 1} (1+q_G)R$, reintroducing the indices we had dropped \begin{align} \esps{t -k - 1}{|E|} \leq \frac{\mathcal{G}_{t - k, i}^2}{2 \sqrt{\epsilon+\tilde{v}_{t, k + 1, i}}} + \frac{2 (1+q_G)R}{\sqrt{1 - \beta_1}} \sqrt{k+1} \esps{t-k-1}{\frac{(g_{t -k, i}+\delta_{t-k,i})^2}{\epsilon + v'_{t, i}}}. \end{align}
nodes.statement_short: Use r <= sqrt(k+1)(1+q_G)R.
nodes.section: A.10 Proof of Lemma lemma:bound_on_C (Lower Bound on Term C)

nodes.name: Full expectation
nodes.statement: Taking the complete expectation and using that by definition $\epsilon + v'_{t, i} \geq \epsilon + \beta_2^k v'_{t-k, i} \geq \beta_2^k (\epsilon + v'_{t - k, i})$ we get \begin{align} \esp{|E|} \leq \frac{1}{2}\esp{\frac{\mathcal{G}_{t - k, i}^2}{\sqrt{\epsilon+\tilde{v}_{t, k+1, i}}}} + \frac{2 (1+q_G)R}{\sqrt{1 - \beta_1}\beta_2^k} \sqrt{k+1} \esp{\frac{(g_{t -k, i}+\delta_{t-k,i})^2}{\epsilon + v'_{t - k, i}}}. \end{align}
nodes.statement_short: Take full expectation and compare v'_t with v'_{t-k}.
nodes.section: A.10 Proof of Lemma lemma:bound_on_C (Lower Bound on Term C)

nodes.name: Conclude lower bound
nodes.statement_short: Sum over i and k to obtain the lower bound on E[C].
nodes.section: A.10 Proof of Lemma lemma:bound_on_C (Lower Bound on Term C)

nodes.name: Jensen on c_j^2
nodes.statement: First, we use Jensen's inequality on $c_j^2$, noting that $\sum_{l=1}^j \beta_1^{j-l} = \frac{1-\beta_1^j}{1-\beta_1} \leq \frac{1}{1-\beta_1}$, to get: \begin{align*} c_{j}^2 = \left(\sum_{l=1}^j \beta_1^{j - l}a_l\right)^2 \leq \left(\sum_{l=1}^j \beta_1^{j-l}\right) \left(\sum_{l=1}^j \beta_1^{j - l}a_l^2\right) \leq \frac{1}{1 - \beta_1}\sum_{l=1}^j \beta_1^{j - l}a_l^2. \end{align*}
nodes.statement_short: Bound c_j^2 by a weighted sum of a_l^2.

nodes.name: Compare denominators
nodes.statement: Dividing by $\epsilon + b_j$ and using the fact that for $l \leq j$, $b_j \geq \beta_2^{j-l}b_l$, which implies $\epsilon + b_j \geq \beta_2^{j-l}(\epsilon + b_l)$, we obtain: \begin{align} \frac{c_{j}^2}{\epsilon + b_{j}} \leq \frac{1}{1 - \beta_1}\sum_{l=1}^j \beta_1^{j - l} \frac{a_l^2}{\epsilon + b_j} \leq \frac{1}{1 - \beta_1}\sum_{l=1}^j \left(\frac{\beta_1}{\beta_2}\right)^{j-l}\frac{a_l^2}{\epsilon + b_l}. \end{align}
nodes.statement_short: Use eps + b_j >= beta2^{j-l}(eps + b_l).

nodes.name: Swap sums
nodes.statement: Now, we sum over $j \in [n]$ and swap the order of summation: \begin{align} \nonumber \sum_{j=1}^n \frac{c_{j}^2}{\epsilon + b_{j}} &\leq \frac{1}{1 - \beta_1}\sum_{j=1}^n\sum_{l=1}^{j}\left(\frac{\beta_1}{\beta_2}\right)^{j -l} \frac{a_{l}^2}{\epsilon + b_{l}} = \frac{1}{1 - \beta_1}\sum_{l=1}^n\frac{a_l^2}{\epsilon + b_l}\sum_{j=l}^{n}\left(\frac{\beta_1}{\beta_2}\right)^{j -l} \\ &\leq \frac{1}{(1 - \beta_1)(1 - \beta_1 /\beta_2)}\sum_{l=1}^n\frac{a_l^2}{\epsilon + b_l}, \end{align} where the last step uses the sum of a geometric series, since $\beta_1/\beta_2 < 1$.
nodes.statement_short: Sum over j and use the geometric series in beta1/beta2.

nodes.name: Logarithmic bound per term
nodes.statement: The next step is to bound the final sum. Let's denote $x_l = a_l^2$. The sum is $\sum_{l=1}^n \frac{x_l}{\epsilon + b_l}$, where $b_l = \sum_{k=1}^l \beta_2^{l-k}x_k$. Note that $b_l - x_l = \beta_2 b_{l-1}$ (with $b_0=0$). Using the inequality $\frac{x}{y} \leq \ln(y) - \ln(y-x)$ for $0 < x < y$, we have: \begin{align*} \frac{x_l}{\epsilon + b_l} &\leq \ln(\epsilon + b_l) - \ln(\epsilon + b_l - x_l) \\ &= \ln(\epsilon + b_l) - \ln(\epsilon + \beta_2 b_{l-1}) \\ &= \ln\left(\frac{\epsilon + b_l}{\epsilon + b_{l-1}}\right) + \ln\left(\frac{\epsilon + b_{l-1}}{\epsilon + \beta_2 b_{l-1}}\right). \end{align*}
nodes.statement_short: Use x/y <= ln y - ln(y - x).

nodes.name: Telescoping
nodes.statement: Summing from $l=1$ to $n$, the first term forms a telescoping series equal to $\ln(\epsilon + b_n) - \ln(\epsilon) = \ln(1 + b_n/\epsilon)$. For the second term, since $\beta_2 \leq 1$ and $b_{l-1} \geq 0$, we have $\frac{\epsilon + \beta_2 b_{l-1}}{\epsilon + b_{l-1}} \geq \beta_2$, which implies $\ln\left(\frac{\epsilon + b_{l-1}}{\epsilon + \beta_2 b_{l-1}}\right) \leq -\ln(\beta_2)$. Thus, summing over $l$ gives: \begin{equation} \sum_{l=1}^n\frac{a_l^2}{\epsilon + b_l} \leq \ln\left(1 + \frac{b_n}{\epsilon}\right) - n\ln(\beta_2). \end{equation} This inequality is a useful result in itself, corresponding to the special case where $c_j^2$ is replaced by $a_j^2$ (or equivalently $\beta_1 \to 0$ and $a_j$ is replaced by $a_j^2$).
nodes.statement_short: Telescope to ln(1 + b_n/eps) - n ln beta2.

nodes.name: Conclude
nodes.statement: Finally, substituting the bound from \eqref{eq:special_case_bound_lemma7} into \eqref{eq:intermediate_bound_lemma7} yields the desired result.
nodes.statement_short: Combine the two bounds.

nodes.name: Define S_K
nodes.statement: Let the sum be denoted by $S_K = \sum_{k = 0}^{K - 1} \rho^k \sqrt{k + 1}$. We analyze the term $(1-\rho)S_K$: \begin{align*} (1 - \rho) S_K &= \sum_{k = 0}^{K - 1} \rho^k \sqrt{k+1} - \sum_{j = 1}^K \rho^{j} \sqrt{j} \\ &= 1 + \sum_{k=1}^{K-1} \rho^k(\sqrt{k+1} - \sqrt{k}) - \rho^K\sqrt{K}. \end{align*}
nodes.statement_short: Define S_K and compute (1-rho)S_K.

nodes.name: Concavity bound
nodes.statement: By the concavity of the square root function, $\sqrt{k+1} - \sqrt{k} \leq \frac{1}{2\sqrt{k}}$. This implies: \begin{align*} (1 - \rho) S_K &\leq 1 + \sum_{k = 1}^{K- 1} \frac{\rho^{k}}{2 \sqrt{k}} \leq 1 + \int_0^{\infty} \frac{\rho^{t}}{2 \sqrt{t}}\mathrm{d}t. \end{align*}
nodes.statement_short: sqrt(k+1)-sqrt(k) <= 1/(2 sqrt k); compare with an integral.

nodes.name: Evaluate the integral
nodes.statement: The integral is a standard Gaussian integral form which evaluates to $\frac{\sqrt{\pi}}{2 \sqrt{-\ln(\rho)}}$. Using the inequality $-\ln(\rho) \geq 1 - \rho$, we have: \begin{align*} (1 - \rho) S_K \leq 1 + \frac{\sqrt{\pi}}{2 \sqrt{1-\rho}} \leq \frac{2}{\sqrt{1-\rho}}. \end{align*}
nodes.statement_short: Evaluate the integral and use -ln rho >= 1 - rho.

nodes.name: Divide
nodes.statement: Dividing by $(1-\rho)$ yields the desired result.
nodes.statement_short: Divide by 1 - rho.

nodes.name: Define S_K and bound (1-rho)S_K
nodes.statement: Let the sum be denoted by $S_K = \sum_{k = 0}^{K - 1} \rho^k \sqrt{k} (k + 1)$. We proceed by analyzing $(1-\rho)S_K$: \begin{align*} (1-\rho)S_K &= \sum_{k = 1}^{K - 1} \rho^k \left[ \sqrt{k} (k + 1) - k\sqrt{k - 1}\right] - \rho^K k \sqrt{K-1} \\ &\leq \sum_{k = 1}^{K - 1} \rho^k (2\sqrt{k}), \end{align*} where the inequality holds because $\sqrt{k} (k + 1) - k\sqrt{k - 1} \le 2\sqrt{k}$.
nodes.statement_short: Bound each term by 2 sqrt k.

nodes.name: Re-index
nodes.statement: Re-indexing the sum gives: \begin{align*} (1 - \rho) S_K &\leq 2 \rho \sum_{k = 1}^{K - 1} \rho^{k-1} \sqrt{k} = 2 \rho \sum_{j = 0}^{K - 2} \rho^j \sqrt{j + 1}. \end{align*}
nodes.statement_short: Re-index to a sum of the Lemma A.3 form.

nodes.name: Apply Lemma A.3
nodes.statement: Applying the result from Lemma~\ref{app:lemma:sum_geom_sqrt} to the final sum, we get: \begin{align*} (1 - \rho) S_K \leq 2 \rho \left( \frac{2}{(1 - \rho)^{3/2}} \right) = \frac{4 \rho}{(1 - \rho)^{3/2}}. \end{align*} Dividing both sides by $(1-\rho)$ completes the proof.
nodes.statement_short: Apply Lemma A.3 and divide by 1 - rho.

nodes.name: Plan
nodes.statement: The proof proceeds by first expanding the term of interest, applying bounds on the moment estimates derived from their recurrence relations, and then leveraging Lemma~\ref{lemma:sum_ratio} to bound the resulting sum.
nodes.statement_short: Expand, bound the moments, apply the sum-of-ratios lemma.

nodes.name: Expand the norm
nodes.statement: We begin by expanding the definition of $\norm{\ub_t}_2^2$, separating the sum over the dimension $d$, and taking the expectation: \begin{align} \sum_{t=1}^T\esp{\norm{\ub_t}^2_2} = \sum_{t=1}^T\esp{\sum_{i\in [d]}\frac{m^2_{t,i}}{\epsilon+v_{t,i}}} = \sum_{i\in [d]}\sum_{t=1}^T\esp{\frac{m^2_{t,i}}{\epsilon+v_{t,i}}}. \end{align}
nodes.statement_short: Write the sum as a sum over coordinates of m^2/(eps+v).

nodes.name: Bound the numerator
nodes.statement: For each coordinate $i$, we bound the numerator $m_{t,i}^2$ from above and the denominator $\epsilon+v_{t,i}$ from below. By unrolling the recurrence for $m_{t,i}$ and applying the triangle inequality along with the relative error model, we get an upper bound on its magnitude: \begin{align} |m_{t, i}| \le \sum_{k=1}^t\beta_1^{t-k}(1+q_M)^{t-k}|\nabla_i f_k(\wb_{k-1}) + \delta_{k,i}|. \end{align}
nodes.statement_short: Unroll m with factor beta1(1+q_M).

nodes.name: Bound the denominator
nodes.statement: For the denominator, Lemma~\ref{app:lemma:moment_relation} provides a lower bound for $v_{t,i}$: \begin{align} v_{t,i} \ge \sum_{k=1}^t\beta_2^{t-k}(1-q_V)^{t-k}(\nabla_i f_k(\wb_{k-1}) + \delta_{k,i})^2. \end{align}
nodes.statement_short: Lower bound v by the moment-relation lemma.

nodes.name: Combined ratio bound
nodes.statement: Substituting these into the sum gives the inequality: \begin{align} \sum_{t=1}^T\esp{\norm{\ub_t}^2_2} \le \sum_{i\in [d]}\sum_{t=1}^T\esp{\frac{\left(\sum_{k=1}^t\beta_1^{t-k}(1+q_M)^{t-k}|\hat{g}_{k,i}|\right)^2}{\epsilon+\sum_{k=1}^t\beta_2^{t-k}(1-q_V)^{t-k}\hat{g}_{k,i}^2}}, \end{align} where for brevity we denote $\hat{g}_{k,i} = \nabla_i f_k(\wb_{k-1}) + \delta_{k,i}$.
nodes.statement_short: Substitute both bounds.

nodes.name: Match the sum-of-ratios lemma
nodes.statement: The inner sum over $t$ for each coordinate $i$ in \eqref{eq:u_bound_intermediate_lemma10} perfectly matches the form required by Lemma~\ref{lemma:sum_ratio}. To apply it, we make the following substitutions into the lemma's notation:
nodes.statement_short: The inner sum matches the sum-of-ratios lemma after substitutions.

nodes.name: Substitute a_k
nodes.statement: \item Let the sequence $(a_j)_{j\in\NN^*}$ be $a_k = |\hat{g}_{k,i}|$.
nodes.statement_short: Set a_k = |g_hat_{k,i}|.

nodes.name: Effective decay factors
nodes.statement: \item Let the effective decay factors be $\beta'_1 = \beta_1(1+q_M)$ and $\beta'_2 = \beta_2(1-q_V)$. The lemma's condition $\beta'_1 < \beta'_2$ is satisfied by our assumption.
nodes.statement_short: Set beta1' = beta1(1+q_M), beta2' = beta2(1-q_V).

nodes.name: Apply the sum-of-ratios lemma
nodes.statement: With these substitutions, the numerator term becomes $\left(\sum_{k=1}^t (\beta'_1)^{t-k} a_k\right)^2 = c_t^2$ and the sum in the denominator becomes $\sum_{k=1}^t (\beta'_2)^{t-k} a_k^2 = b_t$. Applying Lemma~\ref{lemma:sum_ratio} to the sum over $t$ for a fixed $i$ yields: \begin{align} \sum_{t=1}^T \esp{\frac{c_t^2}{\epsilon+b_t}} \le \frac{1}{(1 - \beta'_1)(1 - \beta'_1/\beta'_2)} \left( \ln\left(1 + \frac{b_T}{\epsilon}\right) - T\ln(\beta'_2) \right). \end{align}
nodes.statement_short: Apply the lemma for each coordinate.

nodes.name: Expand b_T
nodes.statement: The final step is to find an upper bound for $b_T$. By definition: \begin{align} b_T = \sum_{k=1}^T (\beta'_2)^{T-k} a_k^2 = \sum_{k=1}^T (\beta_2(1-q_V))^{T-k} \hat{g}_{k,i}^2. \end{align}
nodes.statement_short: Write b_T explicitly.

nodes.name: Bound b_T
nodes.statement: From Lemma~\ref{lemma:grad_bound}, we have a uniform bound on the quantized gradient estimator, $|\hat{g}_{k,i}| \le (1+q_G)R$. Therefore: \begin{align} b_T &\le \sum_{k=1}^T (\beta_2(1-q_V))^{T-k} ((1+q_G)R)^2 \nonumber \\ &= ((1+q_G)R)^2 \sum_{j=0}^{T-1} (\beta_2(1-q_V))^{j} \nonumber \\ &\le ((1+q_G)R)^2 \frac{1}{1 - \beta_2(1-q_V)}. \end{align}
nodes.statement_short: Use the quantized gradient bound and a geometric series.

nodes.name: Conclude
nodes.statement: Substituting the bound for $b_T$ back into \eqref{eq:u_bound_after_lemma_lemma10}, and re-inserting the definitions of $\beta'_1$ and $\beta'_2$, we obtain the bound for a single coordinate $i$. As this bound is identical for all $d$ coordinates, we multiply by $d$ to get the final result stated in \eqref{app:eq:sum_ratio_u_lemma10}. This completes the proof.
nodes.statement_short: Substitute and multiply by d.

nodes.name: Uniform bound U on ||u_t||
nodes.statement_short: Use the Cauchy lemma coordinatewise.
nodes.section: A.15 Proof of Lemma lemma:bound_on_M (Bound on Term M)

nodes.name: Split M
nodes.statement: Now, let's recall the definition of $M$: \begin{equation*} M = \eta_T d \sum_{t=1}^T \esp{\sum_{k=0}^{t-1} \beta_1^k M_{t-k}}, \quad \text{where} \quad M_{t-k} = \frac{q_G R^2 + L q_W R \norm{\wb_{t-k-1}}_2}{\sqrt{\epsilon}}. \end{equation*} We can split $M$ into two components: a constant part $M_{\text{const}}$ and a weight-dependent part $M_{\text{weights}}$. \begin{align*} M_{\text{const}} &= \frac{\eta_T d q_G R^2}{\sqrt{\epsilon}} \sum_{t=1}^T \sum_{k=0}^{t-1} \beta_1^k \\ M_{\text{weights}} &= \frac{\eta_T d L q_W R}{\sqrt{\epsilon}} \sum_{t=1}^T \sum_{k=0}^{t-1} \beta_1^k \esp{\norm{\wb_{t-k-1}}_2} \end{align*}
nodes.statement_short: Split M into constant and weight-dependent parts.
nodes.section: A.15 Proof of Lemma lemma:bound_on_M (Bound on Term M)

nodes.name: Bound M_const
nodes.statement: Bounding $M_{\text{const}}$ is straightforward. The inner sum is a geometric series bounded by $\frac{1}{1-\beta_1}$, so the double summation is bounded by $\frac{T}{1-\beta_1}$. \begin{equation} M_{\text{const}} \le \frac{\eta_T d q_G R^2 T}{\sqrt{\epsilon}(1-\beta_1)}. \end{equation}
nodes.statement_short: Geometric series gives T/(1-beta1).
nodes.section: A.15 Proof of Lemma lemma:bound_on_M (Bound on Term M)

nodes.name: Weight norm growth
nodes.section: A.15 Proof of Lemma lemma:bound_on_M (Bound on Term M)

nodes.name: Swap summation
nodes.statement_short: Swap sums and bound the geometric factor.
nodes.section: A.15 Proof of Lemma lemma:bound_on_M (Bound on Term M)

nodes.name: Substitute linear bound
nodes.statement_short: Sum the linear growth bound.
nodes.section: A.15 Proof of Lemma lemma:bound_on_M (Bound on Term M)

nodes.name: Assemble
nodes.statement_short: Combine M_const and M_weights.
nodes.section: A.15 Proof of Lemma lemma:bound_on_M (Bound on Term M)

nodes.name: Smoothness descent
nodes.statement:
Set $\eta_t = \eta$, denote $r=\min\{m, n\}$, and according to the $L$-smoothness of $F(\cdot)$, we have  egin{align} &\EE[F(\Wb_t)-F(\Wb_{t+1})] 
otag \ \ge& \EE[\la
abla F(\Wb_t), \Wb_t - \Wb_{t+1} a- rac{L}{2}\| \Wb_t - \Wb_{t+1} \|_F^2] 
otag \ =& \EE[\eta \la
abla F(\Wb_t), \Ub_t\Vb_t^{	op} a- rac{L}{2}\eta^2\| \Ub_t\Vb_t^{	op} \|_F^2] 
otag \ \ge& \EE[\eta \la
abla F(\Wb_t), \Ub_t\Vb_t^{	op} a]- rac{L}{2}\eta^2 r 
otag \ =& \EE[\eta \la \Mb_t, \Ub_t\Vb_t^{	op} a + \eta\la
abla F(\Wb_t) - \Mb_t, \Ub_t\Vb_t^{	op} a] - rac{L}{2}\eta^2 r 
otag \ \ge& \EE[\eta\|\Mb_t\|_* - \eta\|
abla F(\Wb_t) - \Mb_t\|_F \cdot \|\Ub_t\Vb_t^{	op} \|_F] - rac{L}{2}\eta^2 r 
otag \ \ge& \EE[\eta\|
abla F(\Wb_t)\|_* - \eta\|
abla F(\Wb_t) - \Mb_t\|_* - \eta\sqrt{r}\|
abla F(\Wb_t) - \Mb_t\|_F] - rac{L}{2}\eta^2 r 
otag \ \ge& \EE[\eta\|
abla F(\Wb_t)\|_* - 2\eta\sqrt{r}\|
abla F(\Wb_t) - \Mb_t\|_F] - rac{L}{2}\eta^2 r. \end{align} The second inequality is due to $\|\Ub_t\Vb_t^{	op}\|_F^2 = 	r(\Vb_t\Ub_t^{	op}\Ub_t\Vb_t^{	op}) \le r=\min\{m,n\}$. The third inequality is due to $\Mb_t = \Ub_t\Sbb_t\Vb_t^{	op}$ and Cauchy-Schwarz inequality. The last inequality we used the fact that $\|\Ab\|_* \le \sqrt{r}\|\Ab\|_F$ for any $\Ab\in\RR^{m	imes n}$.
nodes.statement_short: L-smoothness and nuclear-norm alignment of U V^T give a per-step descent.

nodes.name: Sum over iterations
nodes.statement:
Summing Eq.~\eqref{eq:smooth1} over $t=0,1,\ldots,T-1$, we get  egin{align} & rac{1}{T}\sum_{t=0}^{T-1}\EE[\|
abla F(\Wb_t)\|_*] 
otag \ \le&  rac{\EE[F(\Wb_0) - F^(\Wb_T)]}{T\eta} +  rac{2\sqrt{r}}{T}\sum_{t=0}^{T-1}\EE[\|
abla F(\Wb_t) - \Mb_t\|_F] +  rac{\eta Lr}{2}. \end{align}
nodes.statement_short: Average the descent over T steps.

nodes.name: Telescoping decomposition
nodes.statement:
Next, we focus on term $\EE[\|
abla F(\Wb_t) - \Mb_t\|_F]$. With auxiliary variables defined in Eq.~\eqref{eq:muon_C}-\eqref{eq:muon_Z}, we have  egin{align*} &\EE[\|
abla F(\Wb_t) - \Mb_t\|_F] \ \le& \EE[\|
abla F(\Wb_t) - \Cb_t\|_F + \|\Cb_t - \Xb_t\|_F + \|\Xb_t - \Yb_t\|_F + \|\Yb_t - \Zb_t\|_F + \|\Zb_t - \Mb_t\|_F]. \end{align*}
nodes.statement_short: Split grad F - M_t through C, X, Y, Z.

nodes.name: Apply the five lemmas
nodes.statement:
By Lemmas~ef{lemma:muon_GC},~ef{lemma:muon_CX},~ef{lemma:muon_XY},~ef{lemma:muon_YZ}, and~ef{lemma:muon_ZM}, we have  egin{align*} &\EE[\|
abla F(\Wb_t) - \Mb_t\|_F] \ \le& \EE[ \|
abla F(\Wb_t) - \Cb_t\|_F + \|\Cb_t - \Xb_t\|_F + \|\Xb_t - \Yb_t\|_F + \|\Yb_t - \Zb_t\|_F + \|\Zb_t - \Mb_t\|_F ] \ \le&  rac{ eta L\eta\sqrt{r}}{1- eta} +  eta^t rac{3\sigma}{\sqrt{B}}+\sqrt{ rac{1- eta}{1+ eta}} rac{3\sigma}{\sqrt{B}} + 3q_G(\sigma + G) + 3q_G T\eta\sqrt{r}L + q_W(1+q_G)DL + \ & q_W(1+q_G)T\eta\sqrt{r}L +  rac{q_M eta}{1- eta(1+q_M)} igg(  rac{\sigma}{\sqrt{B}} + \sqrt{ rac{1- eta}{1+ eta}}\cdot rac{\sigma}{\sqrt{B}} + G + q_G(\sigma + G) + 
otag  igg.\ & igg. q_W (1+q_G)DL + (1+q_W)(1+q_G)T\eta\sqrt{r}L  igg). \end{align*}
nodes.statement_short: Bound each difference by its lemma.

nodes.name: Sum the momentum error
nodes.statement:
Summing over $t=0,1,\ldots,T-1$, we get  egin{align} & rac{1}{T}\sum_{t=0}^{T-1}\EE[\|
abla F(\Wb_t) - \Mb_t\|_F] 
otag \ \le&  rac{ eta L\eta\sqrt{r}}{1- eta} +  rac{3\sigma}{T(1- eta)\sqrt{B}} + \sqrt{ rac{1- eta}{1+ eta}} rac{3\sigma}{\sqrt{B}} + 3q_G(\sigma + G) + 3q_G T\eta\sqrt{r}L + q_W(1+q_G)DL + 
otag \ & q_W(1+q_G)T\eta\sqrt{r}L +  rac{q_M eta}{1- eta(1+q_M)} igg(  rac{\sigma}{\sqrt{B}} + \sqrt{ rac{1- eta}{1+ eta}}\cdot rac{\sigma}{\sqrt{B}} + G + q_G(\sigma + G) + 
otag  igg. 
otag \ & igg. q_W (1+q_G)DL + (1+q_W)(1+q_G)T\eta\sqrt{r}L  igg). \end{align}
nodes.statement_short: Average the momentum-error bound over t.

nodes.name: Full bound
nodes.statement:
Substitute~\eqref{eq:muon_sum_GM} into~\eqref{eq:muon_sum_smooth}, with Assumption~ef{assump:qe}, we have  egin{align*} & rac{1}{T}\sum_{t=0}^{T-1}\EE[\| 
abla F(\Wb_t) \|_*] \ \le&  rac{\EE[F(\Wb_0)-F(\Wb_T)]}{\eta T} +  rac{L\eta r}{2}+ rac{2\sqrt{r}}{T}\sum_{t=0}^{T-1}\EE[\|
abla F(\Wb_t) - \Mb_t\|_F] \ \le&  rac{\EE[F(\Wb_0)-F(\Wb_T)]}{\eta T} +  rac{L\eta r}{2}+  rac{2 eta L\eta r}{1- eta} +  rac{6\sigma\sqrt{r}}{T(1- eta)\sqrt{B}}+\sqrt{ rac{1- eta}{1+ eta}} rac{6\sigma\sqrt{r}}{\sqrt{B}} +
otag \ & 6q_G\sqrt{r}(\sigma + G) + 6q_G T\eta r L + 2q_W(1+q_G)DL\sqrt{r} + 2q_W(1+q_G)T\eta r L + 
otag \ &  rac{2q_M eta\sqrt{r}}{1- eta(1+q_M)} igg(  rac{\sigma}{\sqrt{B}} + \sqrt{ rac{1- eta}{1+ eta}}\cdot rac{\sigma}{\sqrt{B}} + G + q_G(\sigma + G) + 
otag  igg.\ & igg. q_W (1+q_G)DL + (1+q_W)(1+q_G)T\eta \sqrt{r} L  igg) \ \le&  rac{\EE[F(\Wb_0)-F(\Wb_T)]}{\eta T} +  rac{L\eta r}{2}+  rac{2 eta L\eta r}{1- eta} +  rac{6\sigma\sqrt{r}}{T(1- eta)\sqrt{B}}+ \sqrt{ rac{1- eta}{1+ eta}} rac{6\sigma\sqrt{r}}{\sqrt{B}} + \ &\Theta\Bigg(q_G+ q_W + q_G T\eta + q_W T\eta +  rac{q_M eta}{1- eta(1+q_M)} igg(1+\sqrt{1- eta} + q_G + q_W + T\eta igg) \Bigg). \end{align*}
nodes.statement_short: Substitute into the averaged descent inequality.

nodes.name: Full-precision terms
nodes.statement: Let $F(\Wb_0) - F^* \le \Delta$, where $\Delta > 0$ is a constant. By setting $B=1$, $1-\beta = \Theta(T^{-1/2})$, $\eta = \Theta((1-\beta)^{1/2}T^{-1/2})$, we have $T\eta = \Theta(T^{1/4})$. Then we have \begin{align*} \frac{\EE[F(\Wb_0)-F(\Wb_T)]}{\eta T} + \frac{L\eta r}{2}+ \frac{2\beta L\eta r}{1-\beta} + \frac{6\sigma\sqrt{r}}{T(1-\beta)\sqrt{B}}+\sqrt{\frac{1-\beta}{1+\beta}}\frac{6\sigma\sqrt{r}}{\sqrt{B}} = \cO(\frac{1}{T^{1/4}}). \end{align*}
nodes.statement_short: With B=1, 1-beta=Theta(T^{-1/2}) the full-precision terms are O(T^{-1/4}).

nodes.name: Momentum condition
nodes.statement: Moreover, with condition $\beta(1+q_M) < 1$, suppose $1-\beta = C_\beta T^{-1/2}$, $C_\beta > 0$ is a constant. Choose $q_M = C_M T^{-1/2}$, where $C_M < C_\beta, C_M > 0$ is a constant, then we have \begin{align*} \beta(1+q_M) = (1 - C_\beta T^{-1/2})(1 + C_M T^{-1/2}) = 1 - (C_\beta - C_M)T^{-1/2} - C_\beta C_M T^{-1} < 1. \end{align*}
nodes.statement_short: q_M = C_M T^{-1/2} keeps beta(1+q_M) < 1.

nodes.name: Quantization terms
nodes.statement: Thus, by setting $q_G = \cO(T^{-1/2})$, $q_W = \cO(T^{-1/2})$, $q_M = \cO(T^{-1/2})$, we have \begin{align*} &q_G+ q_W + q_G T\eta + q_W T\eta + \frac{q_M\beta}{1-\beta(1+q_M)}\bigg(1+\sqrt{1-\beta} + q_G + q_W + T\eta\bigg) \\ =& \cO(T^{-1/2} + T^{-1/2}T^{1/4} + T^{-1/2}(1+T^{-1/4}+T^{-1/2}+T^{1/4})) \\ =& \cO(T^{-1/4}), \end{align*} where we used the fact $\frac{q_M\beta}{1-\beta(1+q_M)} = \cO(q_M\beta(1+\beta(1+q_M))) = \cO(T^{-1/2})$, and $\beta(1+q_M) < 1$.
nodes.statement_short: Quantization terms are O(T^{-1/4}).

nodes.name: Conclude
nodes.statement: Combining the above results, with the fact that $\|\Ab\|_* \ge \|\Ab\|_F$ for any matrix $\Ab$, we complete the proof.

nodes.name: Weight norm bound
nodes.statement: According to the update of Muon, we have \begin{align*} & \|\Wb_t\|_F \\ =& \|\Wb_{t-1} - \eta\Ub_t\Vb_t^{\top}\|_F \\ \le& \|\Wb_{t-1}\|_F + \eta \|\Ub_t\Vb_t^{\top}\|_F \\ =& \|\Wb_{t-1}\|_F + \eta\sqrt{\tr(\Vb_t\Ub_t^{\top}\Ub_t\Vb_t^{\top})} \\ \le& \|\Wb_{t-1}\|_F + \eta\sqrt{r} \\ \le& \|\Wb_0\|_F + t\eta\sqrt{r} \\ \le& D + t\eta\sqrt{r}. \end{align*}
nodes.statement_short: Each step changes W by at most eta sqrt(r).

nodes.name: Gradient norm bound
nodes.statement:
The third inequality is because $\Ub_t$ and $\Vb_t$ are orthogonal matrices, and the last inequality is due to Assumption~ef{assump:bound_init}.  egin{align*} & \|
abla F(\Wb_t)\|_F \ \le& \|
abla F(\Wb_0)\|_F + \sum_{k=0}^{t-1} \|
abla F(\Wb_{k+1}) - 
abla F(\Wb_k)\|_F \ \le& G + \sum_{k=0}^{t-1} L\|\Wb_{k+1} - \Wb_k\|_F \ \le& G + \sum_{k=0}^{t-1} L\eta\sqrt{r} \ =& G + t\eta\sqrt{r}L. \end{align*} The first inequality is due to the triangle inequality, the second inequality is due to Assumption~ef{assump:smooth}, and the last inequality is due to the update of Muon.
nodes.statement_short: Telescoping with L-smoothness bounds the gradient norm.

nodes.name: Unroll momenta
nodes.statement: Expanding $\Cb_t$ and $\Xb_t$ by their definitions in \eqref{eq:muon_C} and \eqref{eq:muon_X}, we have \begin{align*} \Cb_t =& \beta^t\Cb_0 + (1-\beta)\sum_{k=1}^t\beta^{t-k}\nabla F(\Wb_k) , \\ \Xb_t =& \beta^t\Xb_0 + (1-\beta)\sum_{k=1}^t\beta^{t-k}\frac{1}{B}\sum_{i=1}^B\nabla f(\Wb_k;\bxi_{k,i}). \end{align*}
nodes.statement_short: Unroll C_t and X_t.

nodes.name: Variance bound
nodes.statement:
Thus, we have  egin{align*} &\EE[\|\Cb_t - \Xb_t\|_F] \ \le& \EE[\| eta^t(\Cb_0 - \Xb_0)\|_F] + \EE[(1- eta)\|\sum_{k=1}^t eta^{t-k}(
abla F(\Wb_k)- rac{1}{B}\sum_{i=1}^B
abla f(\Wb_k; xi_{k,i}))\|_F] \ \le&  eta^t\EE[\|\Cb_0 - \Xb_0\|_F] + \sqrt{\EE[(1- eta)^2\|\sum_{k=1}^t eta^{t-k}(
abla F(\Wb_k)- rac{1}{B}\sum_{i=1}^B
abla f(\Wb_k; xi_{k,i}))\|_F^2]} \ =&  eta^t\EE[\|\Cb_0 - \Xb_0\|_F] + \sqrt{\EE[(1- eta)^2\sum_{k=1}^t eta^{2(t-k)} rac{1}{B^2}\sum_{i=1}^B\|
abla F(\Wb_k; xi_{k,i})-
abla F(\Wb_k)\|_F^2]} \ \le&  eta^t\EE[\|\Cb_0 - \Xb_0\|_F] + \sqrt{(1- eta)^2\sum_{k=1}^t eta^{2(t-k)} rac{\sigma^2}{B}} \ \le&  eta^t rac{\sigma}{\sqrt{B}} + \sqrt{ rac{1- eta}{1+ eta}} rac{\sigma}{\sqrt{B}}. \end{align*} The second inequality is due to Jensen's inequality, the first equality is due to the independence of $ xi_{k,i}$ for different $k$ or $i$, and the third inequality is due to Assumptions~ef{assump:grad_unbiased} and~ef{assump:grad_bounds}.
nodes.statement_short: Jensen and independence bound the difference by sigma/sqrt B terms.

nodes.name: Recursive bound
nodes.statement:
By the definition of $\Xb_t$ and $\Yb_t$ in \eqref{eq:muon_X} and \eqref{eq:muon_Y}, we have  egin{align*} &\EE[\| \Xb_t - \Yb_t \|_F]
otag\ \le& \EE[ eta \| \Xb_{t-1} - \Yb_{t-1} \|_F] + (1- eta) rac{1}{B}\sum_{i=1}^B\EE[\| 
abla f(\Wb_t; xi_{t,i}) - 
abla^Q f(\Wb_t; xi_{t,i}) \|_F] 
otag \ \le& \EE[ eta \| \Xb_{t-1} - \Yb_{t-1} \|_F] + (1- eta) rac{1}{B}\sum_{i=1}^B\EE[ q_G\| 
abla f(\Wb_t; xi_{t,i}) \|_F] 
otag \ \le& \EE[ eta \| \Xb_{t-1} - \Yb_{t-1} \|_F] + (1- eta)\EE[ q_G(\sigma + \| 
abla F(\Wb_t) \|_F )] 
otag \ \le& \EE[ eta \| \Xb_{t-1} - \Yb_{t-1} \|_F] + (1- eta) q_G(\sigma + G + t\eta\sqrt{r}L ) 
otag \ \le&  eta^t\|\Xb_0 - \Yb_0\|_F + (1- eta) q_G(\sigma + G + t\eta\sqrt{r}L )\sum_{k=0}^{t-1} eta^k 
otag \ \le&  eta^t q_G(\sigma + G) + (1- eta^t) q_G(\sigma + G + t\eta\sqrt{r}L ) 
otag \ \le& q_G(\sigma + G) + (1- eta^t)q_G t\eta\sqrt{r}L 
otag \ \le& q_G(\sigma + G + t\eta\sqrt{r}L ). \end{align*}
nodes.statement_short: Recursively bound X_t - Y_t by relative gradient error.

nodes.name: Justifications
nodes.statement: The second inequality is due to Assumption~\ref{assump:qe}, Lemma~\ref{lemma:muon_mat_qe} and Definition~\ref{eq:muon_var_qe}. The third inequality is due to Assumption~\ref{assump:grad_bounds}. The fourth inequality is due to Lemma~\ref{lemma:muon_bounded_w_grad}.
nodes.statement_short: Cite relative error, variance bound and the gradient growth lemma.

nodes.name: Decomposition
nodes.statement:
By the definition of $\Yb_t$ and $\Zb_t$ in \eqref{eq:muon_Y} and \eqref{eq:muon_Z}, we have  egin{align*} \Yb_t =&  eta^t\Yb_0 + (1- eta)\sum_{k=1}^t eta^{t-k} rac{1}{B}\sum_{i=1}^B
abla^Q f(\Wb_k; xi_{k,i}) , \ \Zb_t =&  eta^t\Zb_0 + (1- eta)\sum_{k=1}^t eta^{t-k} rac{1}{B}\sum_{i=1}^B
abla^Q f(\Wb_k^Q; xi_{k,i}) . \end{align*} Thus, by the triangle inequality, we have  egin{align} &\EE[\| \Yb_t - \Zb_t \|_F]
otag\ \le& \EE[ eta^t \| \Yb_{0} - \Zb_{0} \|_F] + (1- eta)\EE[\|\sum_{k=1}^t eta^{t-k}\cdot( rac{1}{B}\sum_{i=1}^B 
abla^Q f(\Wb_k; xi_{k,i}) - 
abla^Q f(\Wb_k^Q; xi_{k,i}) ) \|_F] 
otag \ \le& \EE[ eta^t \| \Yb_{0} - \Zb_{0} \|_F] + \underbrace{(1- eta)\EE[\|\sum_{k=1}^t eta^{t-k}\cdot( rac{1}{B}\sum_{i=1}^B 
abla^Q f(\Wb_k; xi_{k,i}) -
abla f(\Wb_k; xi_{k,i}) \|_F]}_{	ext{\large A}} + 
otag \ & \underbrace{(1- eta)\EE[\|\sum_{k=1}^t eta^{t-k}\cdot( rac{1}{B}\sum_{i=1}^B
abla f(\Wb_k; xi_{k,i}) - 
abla F(\Wb_k))\|_F]}_{	ext{\large C}} + 
otag \ & \underbrace{(1- eta)\EE[\|\sum_{k=1}^t eta^{t-k}\cdot(
abla F(\Wb_k) - 
abla F(\Wb_k^Q))\|_F]}_{	ext{\large H}} + 
otag \ & \underbrace{(1- eta) \EE[\|\sum_{k=1}^t eta^{t-k}\cdot(
abla F(\Wb_k^Q) -  rac{1}{B}\sum_{i=1}^B
abla f(\Wb_k^Q; xi_{k,i}) ) \|_F]}_{	ext{\large I}} + 
otag \ & \underbrace{(1- eta) \EE[\|\sum_{k=1}^t eta^{t-k}\cdot( rac{1}{B}\sum_{i=1}^B
abla f(\Wb_k^Q; xi_{k,i}) - 
abla^Q f(\Wb_k^Q; xi_{k,i}) ) \|_F]}_{	ext{\large J}}. \end{align} Next, we bound each term in \eqref{eq:muon_YZ_decomp} one by one.
nodes.statement_short: Decompose Y_t - Z_t into initial and terms A, C, H, I, J.

nodes.name: Initial term
nodes.statement:
\paragraph{Bound on $ eta^t \EE[\| \Yb_{0} - \Zb_{0} \|_F]$.} By the definitions of $\Yb_0$ and $\Zb_0$ in \eqref{eq:muon_Y} and \eqref{eq:muon_Z}, we have  egin{align*} \Yb_0 =&  rac{1}{B}\sum_{i=1}^B
abla^Q f(\Wb_0; xi_{0,i}), \ \Zb_0 =&  rac{1}{B}\sum_{i=1}^B
abla^Q f(\Wb_0^Q; xi_{0,i}). \end{align*} Thus, we have  egin{align} & eta^t \EE[\| \Yb_{0} - \Zb_{0} \|_F] 
otag \ =&  eta^t \EE[\| rac{1}{B}\sum_{i=1}^B
abla^Q f(\Wb_0; xi_{0,i}) -  rac{1}{B}\sum_{i=1}^B
abla^Q f(\Wb_0^Q; xi_{0,i})\|_F] 
otag \ \le&  eta^t  rac{1}{B}\sum_{i=1}^B \EE[\|
abla^Q f(\Wb_0; xi_{0,i}) - 
abla f(\Wb_0; xi_{0,i})\|_F] + 
otag \ &  eta^t \EE[\| rac{1}{B}\sum_{i=1}^B
abla f(\Wb_0; xi_{0,i}) - 
abla F(\Wb_0)\|_F] + 
otag \ &  eta^t \EE[\|
abla F(\Wb_0) - 
abla F(\Wb_0^Q)\|_F] + 
otag \ &  eta^t \EE[\| rac{1}{B}\sum_{i=1}^B
abla F(\Wb_0^Q) - 
abla f(\Wb_0^Q; xi_{0,i}) \|_F] + 
otag \ &  eta^t  rac{1}{B}\sum_{i=1}^B \EE[\|
abla f(\Wb_0^Q; xi_{0,i}) - 
abla^Q f(\Wb_0^Q; xi_{0,i}) \|_F] 
otag \ \le&  eta^t rac{1}{B}\sum_{i=1}^B q_G\EE[\|
abla f(\Wb_0; xi_{0,i})\|_F] +  eta^t rac{\sigma}{\sqrt{B}} +  eta^t L q_W\EE[\|\Wb_0\|_F] +  eta^t rac{\sigma}{\sqrt{B}} + 
otag \ &  eta^t rac{1}{B}\sum_{i=1}^B q_G\EE[\|
abla f(\Wb_0^Q; xi_{0,i})\|_F] 
otag \ \le&  eta^t rac{1}{B}\sum_{i=1}^B q_G(\sigma + G) +  eta^t rac{2\sigma}{\sqrt{B}} +  eta^t q_W DL +  eta^t rac{1}{B}\sum_{i=1}^B q_G(\sigma+q_W D L+G) 
otag \ =&  eta^t(2q_G(\sigma+G) + q_W DL(1+q_G)+  rac{2\sigma}{\sqrt{B}} ). \end{align} The first inequality is due to the triangle inequality. The second inequality we used Definition~ef{eq:muon_var_qe} for the first and last terms, Assumption~ef{assump:grad_unbiased},~ef{assump:grad_bounds} and Jensen's inequality for the second and fourth terms, and Assumption~ef{assump:smooth} and Definition~ef{eq:muon_var_qe} for the third term. The third inequality is due to Assumption~ef{assump:grad_bounds},~ef{assump:bound_init} and Definition~ef{eq:muon_var_qe}.
nodes.statement_short: Bound the initial difference.

nodes.name: Term A
nodes.statement:
\paragraph{Bound on 	ext{\large A}.}  egin{align} A =& (1- eta)\EE[\|\sum_{k=1}^t eta^{t-k}\cdot( rac{1}{B}\sum_{i=1}^B 
abla^Q f(\Wb_k; xi_{k,i}) -
abla f(\Wb_k; xi_{k,i}) \|_F] 
otag \ \le& (1- eta)\sum_{k=1}^t eta^{t-k} rac{1}{B}\sum_{i=1}^B q_G\EE[\| 
abla f(\Wb_k; xi_{k,i}) \|_F] 
otag \ \le& (1- eta)\sum_{k=1}^t eta^{t-k} rac{1}{B}\sum_{i=1}^B q_G(\sigma + \EE[\| 
abla F(\Wb_k) \|_F]) 
otag \ \le& (1- eta)\sum_{k=1}^t eta^{t-k} rac{1}{B}\sum_{i=1}^B q_G(\sigma + G + t\eta\sqrt{r}L) 
otag \ =& (1- eta^t)q_G(\sigma + G + t\eta\sqrt{r}L). \end{align} The first inequality is due to Definition~ef{eq:muon_var_qe} and the triangle inequality. The second inequality is due to Assumption~ef{assump:grad_bounds}. The third inequality is due to Lemma~ef{lemma:muon_bounded_w_grad}.
nodes.statement_short: Bound the gradient-quantization term A.

nodes.name: Term C
nodes.statement_short: Variance bound for C.

nodes.name: Term H
nodes.statement:
\paragraph{Bound on 	ext{\large H}.}  egin{align} H =& (1- eta)\EE[\|\sum_{k=1}^t eta^{t-k}\cdot(
abla F(\Wb_k) - 
abla F(\Wb_k^Q))\|_F] 
otag \ \le& (1- eta)\sum_{k=1}^t eta^{t-k}\EE[\| 
abla F(\Wb_k) - 
abla F(\Wb_k^Q) \|_F] 
otag \ \le& (1- eta)\sum_{k=1}^t eta^{t-k}L\EE[\| \Wb_k - \Wb_k^Q \|_F] 
otag \ \le& (1- eta)\sum_{k=1}^t eta^{t-k}Lq_W\EE[\| \Wb_k \|_F] 
otag \ \le& (1- eta)\sum_{k=1}^t eta^{t-k}Lq_W(D + t\eta\sqrt{r} ) 
otag \ \le& (1- eta^t)q_W L(D + t\eta\sqrt{r} ). \end{align} The first inequality is due to the triangle inequality. The second inequality is due to Assumption~ef{assump:smooth}. The third inequality is due to Definition~ef{eq:muon_var_qe}. The fourth inequality is due to Lemma~ef{lemma:muon_bounded_w_grad}.
nodes.statement_short: Weight-quantization term H via smoothness.

nodes.name: Term I
nodes.statement_short: Variance bound for I.

nodes.name: Term J
nodes.statement:
\paragraph{Bound on 	ext{\large J}.}  egin{align} J =& (1- eta) \EE[\|\sum_{k=1}^t eta^{t-k}\cdot( rac{1}{B}\sum_{i=1}^B
abla f(\Wb_k^Q; xi_{k,i}) - 
abla^Q f(\Wb_k^Q; xi_{k,i}) ) \|_F] 
otag \ \le& (1- eta) \sum_{k=1}^t eta^{t-k} rac{1}{B}\sum_{i=1}^B q_G\EE[\| 
abla f(\Wb_k^Q; xi_{k,i}) \|_F] 
otag \ \le& (1- eta) \sum_{k=1}^t eta^{t-k} rac{1}{B}\sum_{i=1}^B q_G(\sigma + \EE[\| 
abla F(\Wb_k^Q) \|_F]) 
otag \ \le& (1- eta) \sum_{k=1}^t eta^{t-k} rac{1}{B}\sum_{i=1}^B q_G(\sigma + L\EE[\| \Wb_k^Q -\Wb_k \|_F] + \EE[\| 
abla F(\Wb_k) \|_F]) 
otag \ \le& (1- eta) \sum_{k=1}^t eta^{t-k} rac{1}{B}\sum_{i=1}^B q_G(\sigma + Lq_W\EE[\| \Wb_k \|_F] + \EE[\| 
abla F(\Wb_k) \|_F]) 
otag \ \le& (1- eta) \sum_{k=1}^t eta^{t-k} rac{1}{B}\sum_{i=1}^B q_G(\sigma + Lq_W( D + t\eta\sqrt{r}) + G + t \eta\sqrt{r}L) 
otag \ \le& (1- eta^t)q_G(\sigma + G + q_W D L + (1+q_W)t\eta\sqrt{r}L). \end{align} The first inequality is due to Definition~ef{eq:muon_var_qe} and the triangle inequality. The second inequality is due to Assumption~ef{assump:grad_bounds}. The third inequality is due to Assumption~ef{assump:smooth} and the triangle inequality. The fourth inequality is due to Definition~ef{eq:muon_var_qe}. The fifth inequality is due to Lemma~ef{lemma:muon_bounded_w_grad}.
nodes.statement_short: Gradient-quantization at quantized weights.

nodes.name: Combine for Y - Z
nodes.statement: \paragraph{Bound on $\EE[\| \Yb_t - \Zb_t \|_F]$.} Substituting \eqref{eq:muon_YZ_0}, \eqref{eq:muon_YZ_A}, \eqref{eq:muon_YZ_C}, \eqref{eq:muon_YZ_H}, \eqref{eq:muon_YZ_I} and \eqref{eq:muon_YZ_J} into \eqref{eq:muon_YZ_decomp}, we have \begin{align*} \EE[\| \Yb_t - \Zb_t \|_F] \le& \beta^t\cdot\frac{2\sigma}{\sqrt{B}} + \sqrt{\frac{1-\beta}{1+\beta}}\cdot\frac{2\sigma}{\sqrt{B}} + 2q_G(\sigma + G) + (1-\beta^t)2q_G t\eta\sqrt{r}L + \\ & q_W(1+q_G)DL + (1-\beta^t)q_W(1+q_G)t\eta\sqrt{r}L. \\ \le& \beta^t\cdot\frac{2\sigma}{\sqrt{B}} + \sqrt{\frac{1-\beta}{1+\beta}}\cdot\frac{2\sigma}{\sqrt{B}} + 2q_G(\sigma + G) + 2q_G t\eta\sqrt{r}L + \\ & q_W(1+q_G)DL + q_W(1+q_G)t\eta\sqrt{r}L. \end{align*}
nodes.statement_short: Substitute all term bounds.

nodes.name: Bound on ||Z_t||
nodes.statement:
\paragraph{Bound on $\EE[\|\Zb_t\|_F]$.} By the definition of $\Zb_t$ in \eqref{eq:muon_Z}, we have  egin{align*} & \EE[\|\Zb_t\|_F] \ \le& \EE[ eta^t\|\Zb_0\|_F] + \EE[(1- eta)\|\sum_{k=1}^t eta^{t-k}\cdot rac{1}{B}\sum_{i=1}^B 
abla^Q f(\Wb_k^Q; xi_{k,i}) \|_F] \ \le&  eta^t\EE[\|\Zb_0\|_F] + \EE[(1- eta)\sum_{k=1}^t eta^{t-k}\cdot rac{1}{B}\sum_{i=1}^B \|
abla^Q f(\Wb_k^Q; xi_{k,i}) - 
abla f(\Wb_k^Q; xi_{k,i})\|_F] + \ & \EE[(1- eta)\|\sum_{k=1}^t eta^{t-k}\cdot( rac{1}{B}\sum_{i=1}^B 
abla f(\Wb_k^Q; xi_{k,i}) - 
abla F(\Wb_k^Q)) \|_F] + \ & \EE[(1- eta)\sum_{k=1}^t eta^{t-k}\cdot(\|
abla F(\Wb_k^Q) - 
abla F(\Wb_k)\|_F + \|
abla F(\Wb_k)\|_F)] \ \le&  eta^t\EE[\|\Zb_0\|_F] + (1- eta)\sum_{k=1}^t eta^{t-k} rac{1}{B}\sum_{i=1}^B q_G\EE[\|
abla f(\Wb_k^Q; xi_{k,i})\|_F] + \ & \sqrt{ rac{1- eta}{1+ eta}}\cdot rac{\sigma}{\sqrt{B}} + (1- eta)q_W L\sum_{k=1}^t eta^{t-k}\EE[\|\Wb_k\|_F] + (1- eta)\sum_{k=1}^t eta^{t-k}\EE[\|
abla F(\Wb_k)\|_F] \ \le&  eta^t\EE[\|\Zb_0\|_F] + (1- eta)\sum_{k=1}^t eta^{t-k} rac{1}{B}\sum_{i=1}^B q_G(\sigma + q_W L\EE[\|\Wb_k\|_F] + \EE[\|
abla F(\Wb_k)\|_F]) + \ & \sqrt{ rac{1- eta}{1+ eta}}\cdot rac{\sigma}{\sqrt{B}} + (1- eta)q_W L\sum_{k=1}^t eta^{t-k}\EE[\|\Wb_k\|_F] + (1- eta)\sum_{k=1}^t eta^{t-k}\EE[\|
abla F(\Wb_k)\|_F] \ \le&  eta^t\EE[\|\Zb_0\|_F] + (1- eta^t)q_G(\sigma + q_W L(D + t\eta\sqrt{r}) + G + t\eta\sqrt{r}L) + \ & \sqrt{ rac{1- eta}{1+ eta}}\cdot rac{\sigma}{\sqrt{B}} + (1- eta^t)q_W L(D+ t\eta\sqrt{r}) + (1- eta^t)(G + t\eta\sqrt{r}L) \ \le&  eta^t(q_G(\sigma + q_W D L + G) +  rac{\sigma}{\sqrt{B}} + q_W D L + G) + \ & (1- eta^t)q_G(\sigma + q_W L(D + t\eta\sqrt{r}) + G + t\eta\sqrt{r}L) + \ & \sqrt{ rac{1- eta}{1+ eta}}\cdot rac{\sigma}{\sqrt{B}} + (1- eta^t)q_W L(D+ t\eta\sqrt{r}) + (1- eta^t)(G + t\eta\sqrt{r}L) \ \le&  eta^t rac{\sigma}{\sqrt{B}} + \sqrt{ rac{1- eta}{1+ eta}}\cdot rac{\sigma}{\sqrt{B}} + G + q_G(\sigma + G) + q_W (1+q_G)DL + \ & (1- eta^t)(1+q_W)(1+q_G)t\eta\sqrt{r}L \ \le&  rac{\sigma}{\sqrt{B}} + \sqrt{ rac{1- eta}{1+ eta}}\cdot rac{\sigma}{\sqrt{B}} + G + q_G(\sigma + G) + q_W (1+q_G)DL + (1+q_W)(1+q_G)t\eta\sqrt{r}L. \end{align*} The first and second inequalities are due to the triangle inequality. The third inequality we used Definition~ef{eq:muon_var_qe} for the second term, Jensen's inequality, Assumptions~ef{assump:grad_unbiased},~ef{assump:grad_bounds} for the third term, Assumption~ef{assump:smooth} and Definition~ef{eq:muon_var_qe} for the fourth term. The fourth inequality we used triangle inequality, Assumptions~ef{assump:grad_bounds},~ef{assump:smooth}, Definition~ef{eq:muon_var_qe}. The fifth inequality is due to Lemma~ef{lemma:muon_bounded_w_grad}.
nodes.statement_short: Bound the norm of Z_t similarly.

nodes.name: Recursive bound
nodes.statement:
By the definitions of $\Zb_t$ and $\Mb_t$ in \eqref{eq:muon_Z} and \eqref{eq:muon_M}, we have  egin{align} &\EE[\| \Zb_t - \Mb_t \|_F]
otag\ \le& \EE[ eta \| \Zb_{t-1} - \Mb_{t-1}^Q \|_F] 
otag \ \le& \EE[ eta \| \Zb_{t-1} - \Mb_{t-1} \|_F + eta\|\Mb_{t-1}-\Mb_{t-1}^Q\|_F ] 
otag \ \le& \EE[ eta \| \Zb_{t-1} - \Mb_{t-1} \|_F +q_M eta\|\Mb_{t-1}\|_F ] 
otag \ \le& \EE[ eta(1+q_M) \| \Zb_{t-1} - \Mb_{t-1} \|_F +q_M eta\|\Zb_{t-1}\|_F ] 
otag \ \le& q_M eta\sum_{k=0}^{t-1} eta^k(1+q_M)^k\|\Zb_{t-k-1}\|_F 
otag \ \le&  rac{q_M eta}{1- eta(1+q_M)} igg(  rac{\sigma}{\sqrt{B}} + \sqrt{ rac{1- eta}{(1+ eta)}}\cdot rac{\sigma}{\sqrt{B}} + G + q_G(\sigma + G) + 
otag  igg.\ & igg. q_W (1+q_G)DL + (1+q_W)(1+q_G)t\eta\sqrt{r}L  igg). \end{align}
nodes.statement_short: Recursion with factor beta(1+q_M) driven by q_M beta ||Z||.

nodes.name: Justifications
nodes.statement: The second inequality is due to the triangle inequality. The third inequality is due to Definition~\ref{eq:muon_var_qe}. The fourth inequality is due to the triangle inequality. The fifth inequality is due to $\Zb_0=\Mb_0$. The last inequality we used Lemma~\ref{lemma:muon_YZ}
nodes.statement_short: Cite triangle inequality, the error definition and the Y-Z lemma.

nodes.name: Transmit quantized weights
nodes.statement: The master maintains full-precision weights $\Wb_t$ but transmits their quantized version $\Wb_t^Q$ to workers.

nodes.name: Compute quantized gradients
nodes.statement: Workers perform forward and backward passes with $\Wb_t^Q$, compute gradients $\nabla f(\Wb_t^Q; \bxi)$, quantize them, and send quantized gradients back.

nodes.name: Update quantized optimizer states
nodes.statement: The master dequantizes gradients, updates quantized optimizer states (e.g., momentum, second moment), and applies the optimizer update. Updated states are re-quantized for storage.

nodes.name: Loop over iterations
nodes.statement: \For{$t = 0, \ldots, T-1$} \State Sample batch $\{\bxi_{t,i}\}_{i=1}^B$ uniformly \Comment{$B$ workers} \State $\Gb_t = \frac{1}{B} \sum_{i=1}^B \nabla^Q f(\Wb_t^Q; \bxi_{t,i})$ \Comment{Master receives $B$ quantized gradients} \State $\Wb_{t+1} = \cA(\Wb_t, \Gb_t, \bTheta, t)$ \Comment{Update by Adam or Muon}

nodes.name: Sample batch
nodes.statement: Sample batch $\{\bxi_{t,i}\}_{i=1}^B$ uniformly \Comment{$B$ workers}

nodes.name: Average quantized gradients
nodes.statement: $\Gb_t = \frac{1}{B} \sum_{i=1}^B \nabla^Q f(\Wb_t^Q; \bxi_{t,i})$ \Comment{Master receives $B$ quantized gradients}
nodes.statement_short: Master averages B quantized gradients at quantized weights.

nodes.name: Optimizer update
nodes.statement: $\Wb_{t+1} = \cA(\Wb_t, \Gb_t, \bTheta, t)$ \Comment{Update by Adam or Muon}
nodes.statement_short: Call Adam or Muon to update the weights.

nodes.name: Unpack hyperparameters
nodes.statement: $\{\beta_1, \beta_2, \epsilon\} \leftarrow \bTheta$

nodes.name: First moment update
nodes.statement: $\Mb_t \leftarrow \beta_1 \Mb_{t-1}^Q + \Gb_t$ if $t>0$ else $\Mb_0 = \Gb_0$
nodes.statement_short: Momentum with quantized previous state.

nodes.name: Second moment update
nodes.statement: $\Vb_t \leftarrow \beta_2 \Vb_{t-1}^Q + \Gb_t^2$ if $t>0$ else $\Vb_0 = \Gb_0^2$
nodes.statement_short: Second moment with quantized previous state.

nodes.name: Return updated weights
nodes.statement: \Return $\Wb_t - \eta_t \Mb_t/\sqrt{{\Vb_t}+ \epsilon\mathbf{1}}$

nodes.name: Unpack hyperparameter
nodes.statement: $\{\beta \} \leftarrow \bTheta$

nodes.name: Momentum update
nodes.statement: $\Mb_t = \beta \Mb_{t-1}^Q + (1-\beta)\Gb_t$ if $t>0$ else $\Mb_0 = \Gb_0$
nodes.statement_short: Momentum with quantized previous state.

nodes.name: SVD of momentum
nodes.statement: $(\Ub_t, \Sbb_t, \Vb_t) = \mathrm{SVD}(\Mb_t)$

nodes.name: Return orthogonalized update
nodes.statement: \Return $\Wb_t - \eta_t \Ub_t\Vb_t^{\top}$
